# Savi Saluwadana

> Savi Saluwadana is a software engineer based in Sri Lanka who builds software in public. His project repositories document architecture, design decisions and trade-offs; he is exploring platform engineering through containers, CI/CD and developer experience.

This site contains 16 product overviews, including seven repositories that are publicly accessible. Some repository licences are unspecified; public source does not automatically mean open source.

## Site references

- [Product directory](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/): Sixteen project overviews and architecture notes
- [About](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/about/): Profile and public project evidence
- [Engineering architecture](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/engineering/): Architecture and domain trade-offs
- [Agent interfaces](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/engineering/agentic-systems/): Permissions and workflow boundaries
- [Public repositories](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/open-source/): Seven public code repositories and licensing status
- [Engineering insights](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/insights/): Published notes and separately identified article proposals

## Product pages

- [Avara Real Estate](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/avara/): Property discovery, transactions and host operations in Sri Lanka.
- [Blu.lk](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/blu/): Home-service discovery, booking and fulfillment in Sri Lanka.
- [FreshPick / FreshOnTime](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/freshpick/): Food commerce, producer onboarding and scheduled recurring deliveries in Colombo.
- [TimelyHelp.lk](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/timelyhelp/): Product and frontend work for practitioner discovery and consultation journeys.
- [DevRelOS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/devrelos/): A self-hosted beta for discovery, engagement and outcome measurement.
- [Property Management OS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/property-os/): Multi-tenant rental operations and controlled agent-assisted work.
- [RapidReach](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/rapidreach/): Developer publishing and tool discovery with a small CMS.
- [Advance HRIS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/advance-hris/): Hybrid web and local-first desktop HR operations.
- [NexusPOS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/nexus-pos/): Checkout and store operations with an optional Electron desktop shell.
- [Academix](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/academix/): Student, academic and fee operations in a role-aware workspace.
- [Acme Accounting](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/acme-accounting/): Single-company financial operations backed by a double-entry ledger.
- [EventOS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/eventos/): Quick provider matching and full event procurement.
- [Plate Restaurant OS](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/restaurantos/): Restaurant point of sale and coordinated order operations.
- [Pain Intelligence Lab](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/pain-intelligence/): Local research software for exploring repeated needs and evidence-backed project ideas.
- [Ad Performance Analysis Agent](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/ad-performance-agent/): An advertising analytics and reporting prototype.
- [MediCare](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/products/medicare/): Patient administration, appointments, clinical records and billing.

## Published insights

- [Engineering insights](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/insights/): Published architecture notes and five proposed article topics.
- [MCP Permission Boundaries: Keep Agent Tools Behind the Application API](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/insights/mcp-permission-boundaries/): How application services retain authorization when agents use tools.
- [Durable Agentic Workflows: State, Idempotency and Human Approval](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/insights/durable-agentic-workflows/): State, retries, idempotency and approvals in long-running workflows.
- [Go Modular Monolith Architecture for SaaS: Boundaries Before Microservices](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/insights/go-modular-monolith-saas/): Domain boundaries and transaction ownership in a Go application.
- [Platform Engineering: Build a Paved Road Without Hiding the System](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/insights/platform-engineering-paved-road/): Tool-neutral platform delivery contracts, visibility and escape hatches.
- [PostgreSQL Multi-Tenancy: Define Authorization Boundaries Before Schema Tricks](https://savisaluwadana.github.io/insights/postgres-multitenancy-boundaries/): Tenant context, repository contracts and database safeguards.
